name: Iowa
summary: Statutes: legis.iowa.gov per-section PDFs (/docs/code/{section}.pdf, current Iowa Code 2026; /docs/code/{year}/… for past editions) are constructible and short, but the site labels them unofficial; the eight volume PDFs are the official UELMA edition. Constitution, Iowa Acts, the Iowa Court Rules (per-chapter PDFs, official) and the Iowa Administrative Code and Bulletin (official, constructible per chapter, rule and ARC) are all on legis.iowa.gov, which the script reads freely. Case law: iowacourts.gov case pages are constructible from the docket (about 2018 on) and link slip-opinion PDFs; Justia covers 1859/1977 on. Further-review denials are only on a rolling 'latest batch' page or the docket system; grants show up on the Court of Appeals case page for the same docket.

citation_map.notes: Iowa has no public-domain citation; Iowa Reports ended in 1968, so modern cases cite N.W.2d/N.W.3d with '(Iowa YYYY)' or '(Iowa Ct. App. YYYY)'. Court rules carry their chapter in the rule number (1.xxx civil, 2.xxx criminal, 5.xxx evidence, 6.xxx appellate, 32:x.x professional conduct), so law_aliases map rule-set abbreviations to the court-rules chapter used in the URL; the Code aliases map to the statute source. Bare 'rule 1.421' / 'R.C.P. 1.431' (the Iowa Code's own cross-reference style) and bare 'No. 19-0058' dockets are context_required. 'Further review' is also Nebraska's term, so it routes here only with an '(Iowa' parenthetical. Avoid 'I.C.' (Idaho). Unpublished Court of Appeals opinions are cited by docket and date, often with a WL number (Iowa R. App. P. 6.904(2)(c)). The '§§ 614.1-.4' range form is read as its first section. IAC citations use an em dash between agency and chapter and an implementing-statute parenthetical (641—1.1(139A)); the regex accepts hyphen and en dash too. CourtListener ids from memory, unverified.

sources.title: Iowa Code, per-section and per-chapter PDFs (legis.iowa.gov)
sources.official_status_evidence: The Iowa Code page (https://www.legis.iowa.gov/law/iowaCode) labels the title/chapter/section PDF and RTF files 'Unofficial Version'; the eight volume PDFs are the 'Official Version' (see ia-code-volumes-legis). Iowa Code ch. 2B (UELMA, 2019 Iowa Acts ch. 92) governs designation (https://www.legis.iowa.gov/law/officialAndUnofficialEditions).
sources.coverage: Iowa Code editions 2004 to current (Iowa Code 2026, published Dec. 2025). Archive of all editions and supplements 1839- at /archives/code.

access.pattern_rules: section exactly as cited, keeping letters (614.1, 614.4A, 321J.2, 2B.17); case-insensitive (2b.10.pdf works). Without {year} the current edition is served (identical sha256 to /docs/code/2026/614.1.pdf). {year} = Iowa Code edition year (2026, 2025 ... 2004); e.g. /docs/code/2023/614.1.pdf. Whole chapter: /docs/code/[{year}/]{chapter}.pdf (614.pdf, 17 pp.). RTF twin: same path with .rtf. Iowa Code edition N contains acts of the session held in year N-1; acts of the current year's session (effective July 1) are in the next edition only.
access.navigation: Only needed to list a chapter's sections: /law/iowaCode/sections?codeChapter=614&year=2026 lists every section with PDF and RTF links (plain GET). Title pages (/law/iowaCode/chapters?title=XV&year=2026) list chapters; the Iowa Code page shows chapter ranges per title (e.g. 'Title I ... (Ch. 1 - 38D)').
